routing_policy.note: Owner directive 2026-10-13: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on OpenCode Go (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash) at its native variant max is the default and only active OpenCode executor for every lane (/oc, /assure, /ro-review, the launcher, the opencode-subagent MCP and every OpenCode subagent). Step 5 Preview on OpenCode Zen is SUSPENDED and never selected, not even as a fallback. Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a separate authorized Claude-side executor tier and is not an OpenCode profile. Every earlier executor stays retired; its history stays in Git and in the dated records.
routing_policy.selection_authority: Every run resolves the deepseek profile. Re-activating Step needs a new direct Owner instruction recorded in this registry.

resolution_policy.note: Exactly two logical executor profiles. All runtime model IDs below map to one of them; there is no third logical executor and no cross-family substitute. DeepSeek resolves to its pinned Go id; when the live pinned-CLI catalog of the Go provider is inspected the id must be listed, otherwise fail closed. The suspended Step profile is refused before resolution.

cross_executor_review_policy.note: MATERIAL implementation workstreams require a fresh-context READ-ONLY DeepSeek MAX review of the exact validated implementation SHA and TREE before PR_READY or COMPLETE. Only the top-level read-only /ro-review lane (foundry-reviewer) can carry verifiable review evidence; a writable top-level run or a subagent it dispatches never satisfies the gate. While Step is SUSPENDED the implementation executor is also DeepSeek, so the review is same-model and its independence rests on the fresh context and read-only lane alone (review_independence). A later generated-state-only checkpoint may be NON_MATERIAL and preserves the reviewed validated implementation identity without claiming the later state commit was reviewed.
